snippet.title: Hunter: Brotherhood Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
PLAY IT HERE: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2400980887



November 15th, 1991. With the organization threatening to collapse around him, Bratva steward Iosif Pelevin must decide where his loyalty lies as the past comes back to haunt him.
This is the final chapter. Welcome home.



HUNTER: BROTHERHOOD is a custom campaign for Hotline Miami 2: Wrong Number, releasing to the Steam Workshop on Friday, February 19th, 2021 (CST). It will feature 5 levels (medium to very hard in difficulty), several playable characters, custom-made music tracks, hundreds of new sprites, and intricate cutscenes that push Hotline Miami 2's level editor to its very limits.


For the rest of the series:
HUNTER: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=712469445
HUNTER: SNOWFALL: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=853566853
HUNTER: RED STAR: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1375501301



Trailer Credits:

Editing + Thumbnail: THELEGOMack
Gameplay: THELEGOMack, PsychoNamedJerry

Music: "Carnal Encounters of the Third Kind" by Hollywood Burns (used with permission)
